schema_findings.title: FK delete rules defense-in-depth on fiscal/payment surface
schema_findings.evidence: 71 distinct FK constraints — 25 CASCADE (item_allergen, item_branch_availability, junction tables — safe), 26 NO ACTION (orders.branch_id, order_items.order_id — protects against accidental parent delete), 5 RESTRICT (order_payments.order_id, cash_movements.cash_drawer_session_id — hard fail on parent delete), 15 SET NULL (orders.parent_order_id, terminal_id — nullable parent refs). audit_logs & z_reports carry NO FK by design (fiscal isolation, deletes blocked by trigger).

schema_findings.title: Critical query patterns served by composite indexes
schema_findings.evidence: EXPLAIN orders WHERE branch_id=1 AND status='paid' ORDER BY order_datetime → 'Index lookup on orders using idx_orders_branch_status'. EXPLAIN stock_levels WHERE branch_id=1 AND stockable_type=X AND stockable_id=Y → 'Zero rows (no matching row in const table)' via stock_levels_branch_stockable_unique. orders has 9 indexes including 3 UNIQUEs (branch+idempotency_key, branch+fiscal_seq_no, branch+business_date+queue_number, parent_order_id) — strong concurrent-write protection. audit_logs has composite (branch_id, created_at) + UNIQUE (branch_id, prev_hash) chain integrity.

schema_findings.title: audit_logs EXPLAIN shows table scan at 62 rows — expected MySQL behavior below ~100 rows threshold
schema_findings.evidence: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE branch_id=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50 → 'Table scan on audit_logs (cost=7.2 rows=62)'. MySQL planner ignores the audit_logs_branch_id_created_at_index because the full scan + sort is cheaper than index seek for tiny tables. At production scale (>1k rows) the composite index will be used. NO ACTION REQUIRED — observation for synthesis context.

schema_findings.title: Soft-deletes correctly handled at fiscal-critical query sites
schema_findings.evidence: Order uses SoftDeletes trait. FiscalSequenceService.php:97-98 explicit `Order::withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class)->withTrashed()->where('branch_id', $branchId)->lockForUpdate()->max('fiscal_sequence_no')` — soft-deleted post-allocation orders included so fiscal sequence remains gap-free (LOCK_FISCAL_WGS_Z6_P1_2026-05-19 invariant). Sister pattern at ZReportService.php:317-338. Sentinel: Order::restoring throws — soft-delete is one-way audit.

schema_findings.title: audit_logs.branch_id is NULLABLE — chain integrity carried by UNIQUE (branch_id, prev_hash)
schema_findings.evidence: audit_logs.branch_id `bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL` (system-level / cross-branch admin actions allowed). Chain integrity guaranteed by UNIQUE KEY audit_logs_branch_prev_unique (branch_id, prev_hash) + audit_logs_no_update trigger + audit_logs_no_delete trigger. NOT a bug — design intent. Flag as AMBER for synthesis awareness: if a future feature wires NULL branch_id rows into a branch-scoped reporting path, BranchScope cannot filter (no column to filter on) — manual whereNull/where required.

verdict_rationale: All 8 NF525 immutability triggers active. 172/172 migrations in sync. BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest passes with 12 documented exemptions (2 architectural + 10 V1.0.2 BACKLOG, all CLAUDE.md §9 compliant). composition_snapshot write-paths are INSERT-only (PricingService:291 + RefundService:146 counter-entry copy). FK delete rules layered defense-in-depth: RESTRICT on order_payments→orders & cash_movements→drawer_session; NO ACTION on orders.branch_id (no accidental branch wipe); audit_logs+z_reports carry no FK by design + trigger guards DELETE. Soft-delete + withTrashed pattern verified at FiscalSequenceService:97-98 (LOCK_FISCAL_WGS_Z6_P1_2026-05-19 invariant). N+1 surface clean on sampled hot endpoints (OrderService, CashOverview, KDS, StockRupture, Dashboard). Index hygiene strong — composite indexes on branch_id+status, branch_id+created_at, branch_id+fiscal_seq_no, branch_id+business_date+queue_number all present. AMBER tag on audit_logs.branch_id nullable is intentional design (system-level admin actions), flagged for synthesis awareness only.
